headline: This law names a post office in Liberty, Pennsylvania after Staff Sergeant Ryan Scott Ostrom.
what_it_does: It officially designates the Postal Service facility at 4514 Williamson Trail in Liberty, Pennsylvania, as the "Staff Sergeant Ryan Scott Ostrom Post Office." The change is a name only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 20, 2018.
